summary: Pearson plc furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a routine PDMR dealing under UK/EU market-abuse rules, the US-equivalent Form 4-style insider transaction notice. President of Higher Education and Virtual Learning Tom ap Simon acquired 693.248 Pearson ADRs at $15.9905 each, an aggregate $11,085.39, on 21 September 2026 via the Company's Dividend Reinvestment Plan on the NYSE. No board recommendation, advisor, stake threshold, premium, or deal mechanics are implicated. The DRIP purchase reflects an existing holding rather than a directional open-market bet; no risk-arb angle arises and no special-situation catalyst is present.
